title: Desk Reference — Restoring a Cancel-Notified Certificate by Reinstatement Filing (Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing)
content:
## Subject

A Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing certificate (SR-22 or FR-44) whose SR-26 cancellation notice is still pending — the filing shows cancel-notified and the SR-26 has not yet taken effect — is restored by a reinstatement filing sent to the ordering state once the certified Cardinal Personal Auto Policy has been reinstated. The restoration puts the certificate back to accepted.

The reinstatement filing charge is the amount this restoration books. It is booked once, on the reinstatement transmission. State reinstatement fees are not part of this charge.

## What the restoration records

- the filing returns to the status accepted;
- the pending SR-26 effective date on the filing is cleared;
- one reinstatement transmission to the ordering state is recorded under a new transmission confirmation number;
- one filing charge with the reason reinstatement filing is recorded on that transmission, in the amount given.

The customer sees the certificate shown as accepted again and the charge on the filing history.

## Invocation

**Tool:** `restore_certificate_8ba85022` — an agent-side tool. The representative unlocks it and then calls it directly; it is not handed to the customer.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `filing_id` | The filing reference number of the certificate being restored, as returned by the filing lookup for the household | Identifier, as shown in the lookup |
| `reinstatement_charge` | The reinstatement filing charge to book | USD, non-negative, two decimal places; rounded to the cent on entry |

- `filing_id` identifies one filing; a household holding several filings is restored filing by filing.
- `reinstatement_charge` is the charge as already worked out; the tool records the amount it is given and does not calculate it.

### Return

A confirmation sentence naming the filing reference number, the status accepted, the new transmission confirmation number of the reinstatement filing (text beginning with SRT-), and the charge booked in USD with two decimal places. Receiving it means the restoration and its charge were recorded. No other return or error is defined for this tool.

## Illustration (hypothetical values)

Input: `filing_id` = a filing reference taken from the lookup; `reinstatement_charge` = 18.40.
Return: a sentence stating that the filing was restored to accepted, that the reinstatement filing was transmitted under a reference beginning SRT-, and that a charge of 18.40 USD was booked. The amount is invented for the illustration and is not a rate.
